messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: CI alert: multiple workflow failures detected for production-hotfix pipelines (workflow-run ids: 7423xx). Paging on-call for incidents channel.

Alice M.: I'm on it. seeing checkout steps failing with 502/503 from api.github.com and pkg.github.com. root error from runners: "net/http: request canceled (server gave HTTP response to HTTPS client)" and repeated 502s.

Benji R.: same here. logs from a failed job: 
```
2026-05-12T14:02:11Z fetch: GET https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/service/actions/runs/742312/artifacts -> 502 Bad Gateway
2026-05-12T14:02:12Z docker login ghcr.io -> failed: HTTP 502
2026-05-12T14:02:12Z error: connect ECONNRESET
```

Maya K.: Confirmed for GHCR publish step: "failed to upload manifest: received unexpected HTTP status: 502 Bad Gateway". This blocks the hotfix build -> can't push image -> can't create hotfix deploy. :warning: Customers waiting on urgent patch (two enterprise accounts with on-prem connectors).

Ops SRE: Checking GitHub status page: https://www.githubstatus.com/ shows degraded performance for GitHub Actions & Package Registry. Looks like a third-party outage. Please avoid repeated retries at scale.

CI Bot: automatic retries suspended for affected workflows to avoid thundering herd.

Alice M.: Quick diagnostics I ran: 
```
$ curl -v https://api.github.com/ | head -n 20
*   Trying 140.82.112.3:443...
* Connected to api.github.com (140.82.112.3) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake ...
> GET / HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.github.com
> User-Agent: curl/8.2.1
> Accept: */*
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< server: GitHub.com
```
So it's a clear upstream 502.

Benji R.: We need a mitigation plan because this hotfix contains a security fix for token rotation. Options: 1) Wait for GitHub to resolve 2) Build image locally and push to an alternate registry we control (ECR) and update k8s to pull from ECR 3) Build artifacts and hand-deploy binaries to nodes (risky) 4) Try self-hosted runners (but registration and some APIs still hit GitHub).

Maya K.: Self-hosted runners still need GitHub APIs for some actions and for access tokens, so not reliable now. I recommend option 2 (ECR) as fastest workable path.

Ops SRE: Agreed. Plan: build Docker image locally on a trusted machine or CI runner that can access ECR, push to AWS ECR, then perform a controlled k8s rollout referencing the ECR image. We'll need to: 
- generate an image tag (hotfix-1774)
- push to ECR with appropriate auth
- update Deployment with kubectl set image or create new imagePullSecret if needed
- run canary in EU region first (affected customers)

Deploy Bot: Will coordinate manual deploy steps. I can run the manual pipeline when we have the image URL.

Alice M.: Steps I'm about to run (will paste commands as I go):
```
# build
docker build -t inference-service:hotfix-1774 .
# tag for ECR
docker tag inference-service:hotfix-1774 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/inference-service:hotfix-1774
# auth + push
aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
docker push 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/inference-service:hotfix-1774
```
I will not touch production until Ops SRE confirms.

Ops SRE: I will create temporary imagePullSecret and update k8s manifest. Also will scope to the EU deployment first: `kubectl -n prod-eu set image deployment/inference inference=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/inference-service:hotfix-1774 --record` Then watch with `kubectl rollout status`. If canary healthy after 2m, we proceed to global rollout.

Benji R.: I'll take ownership of customer comms. Drafting a short note for affected customers: "We are experiencing a third-party outage affecting GitHub Actions and Package Registry which is preventing our normal hotfix build pipeline. We're implementing a manual build and push to a secondary registry; deploying a targeted canary to EU customers now. ETA for workaround rollout: ~30-45 minutes. We will update in 15-minute intervals." Any objections? :memo:

Maya K.: Sounds good. Include that this is a temporary workaround and final builds will be reconciled to GHCR once GitHub recovers. Also include whether customers need any action (they don't).

CI Bot: Note: once GitHub services recover, we should re-run CI to publish canonical images/artifacts to GHCR and close the temporary ECR usage. I'll create a follow-up ticket to reconcile images and update deployment history.

Deploy Bot: Manual pipeline started by Alice. I see the ECR push completed: `docker push` returned success. Image URL: `123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/inference-service:hotfix-1774`.

Ops SRE: Performing canary update to prod-eu now. `kubectl rollout status` showing pods starting. Health checks passing on new pod. Rolling back if any 5xx spike.

Alice M.: Can confirm readiness probes OK on canary. Latency within baseline. No errors in logs related to the fix itself.

Benji R.: Sent customer note to the two affected enterprise accounts and posted status on status.redwood.ai with the mitigation steps.

Oncall Bot: Incident severity set to S2 (service degradation for a subset of customers) and assigned to Benji R. for the next hour.

Maya K.: Heads-up: after we stabilize, we should run the GHCR publish again and verify checksums. CI Bot will handle the publish attempt once GitHub reports recovered.

Ops SRE: After canary held at 10 minutes with no regressions, proceeding with staged rollout to other clusters. Will throttle to avoid spike.

Alice M.: Hotfix deployed to all regions via ECR fallback. Manual verification completed.

Benji R.: Notifying customers that the hotfix has been applied via alternate registry. We'll follow up when GHCR is back and we've reconciled artifacts.

Maya K.: Logging action items: [1] reconcile images to GHCR (CI Bot ticket) [2] postmortem item: add a documented alternate-publish runbook for GH outages [3] check whether self-hosted runner flow could be hardened for this class of outage.

Ops SRE: Handoff: Benji will own communications, Maya will own reconciliation and follow-up, I'll own the deployment story and runbook updates. Benji, you're on-call — ping if you need support.

Benji R.: Taking the on-call handoff for the next hour. If GitHub recovers or anything regresses, ping @Benji R. :thumbsup:

Oncall Bot: Incident note appended: "Mitigation: manual build/push to ECR and staged rollout. Root cause: upstream GitHub Actions/Package Registry outage (502/503)."

CI Bot: Created follow-up ticket: CI-1829 (reconcile artifacts to GHCR once upstream recovers).

Alice M.: Closing real-time ops thread for active mitigation. Will update this thread when GH status changes or reconciliation begins. :shipit:
